item.name: Curesys Heartleaf Acpair Spot Patch 0.01cm Ultra Thin Acne Patch Blemish Breakouts Pimples (15 pcs / 90pcs)
item.title: Curesys Heartleaf Acpair Spot Patch 0.01cm Ultra Thin Acne Patch Blemish Breakouts Pimples (15 pcs / 90pcs)
item.description:
CURESYS HEARTLEAF ACPAIR SPOT PATCH

#ULTRA THIN #AC CONTROL

4 IN 1 SOLUTION
2 SIZES INSIDE
HIGH CONTENTS OF ACTIVE INGREDIENTS
MADECASSOSIDE, SALICYLIC ACID, HOUTTAUYNIA CORDATA EXTRACT, AND TEATREE OIL

- Protecting acne from air dust is the most effective way to sooth trouble. When pimple breaks out, use Curesys Heartleaf ACPair spot patch. It will prevent secondary infection and relieve acne without leaving scar.

- Most of the other acne patches mainly use tea tree oil only. However, Curesys Heartleaf ACPair spot patch contains 4 complex ingredients. Not only Tea Tree Oil, but also 5,900ppm of Heart Leaf Extract eliminate acne quickly and Salicylic Acid and Madecassoside are added to for fast healing.

- Curesys spot patch is highly adhesive. Ultra thin patch closely adheres onto any skin curves to completely cover skin trouble. Transparent patch without gloss blends in well with all skin tone unnoticeably. 

- Curesys spot patch is available in 2 size. For acne, use 12mm patch and for small break out, use 10mm patch to cover your blemishes.

HOW TO USE
Cleanse blemished skin and allow it to dry. Tear off the release paper along the cutting line to separate patch and apply patch on blemish. Keep the patch on blemish for 8~12 hours and change to new one if needed.

INGREDIENT
Acrylates copolymer, Vinyl Caprolactam/VP/Dimethylaminolethyl Methacrylate Copolymer, Epilobium Angustifolium Flower/Leaf/Stem Extaract, PVP, Butylene Glycol, Houttuynia Cordata Extract(5,900ppm), Salicylic Acid, Sorbic Acid, Phenoxyethanol, Centella Asiatica Extract, Sodium Hydroxide, Sodium metabisulfite, 1,2-Hexanediol, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea tree) Extract, Madecassoside

CAUTION
1. If you experience any allergic reaction, itchiness, or any negative skin reaction, stop using the product and consult doctor. 
2. Do not use on deep cut or infected skin. 
3. Avoid use around eye area. 
4. Do not use for children under 3 years old. 
5. Do not use if your skin is sensitive to plaster or poultice.

STORAGE
Keep away from children. Avoid direct sunlight and store under normal room temperature.

Manufacture and Distributor
TLBKOREA COMPANY LIMITED

COUNTRY OF ORIGIN
Republic of KOREA
